charts.title: WASP-69 b: orbits around WASP-69
charts.description: The orbits of WASP-69's planets in this map from above, to scale, with WASP-69 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Allart et al. 2025 (2025A&A...700A...7A), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname ALLART_ET_AL__2025): P 3.86813881 d

charts.title: WASP-69 b: its transit
charts.description: WASP-69 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (55, 81, 92) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 248853232, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 9-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
